tools.name: balance
tools.description: Your balance in US dollars: what you can spend now and what is held for requests and jobs still running.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change a picture you give (image_url or input_images, as https:// links or data: URIs) following a prompt, with an editing model. Spends from your balance.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Make pictures from a prompt. Spends from your balance; the answer carries the links and what it cost (usage.cost_usd).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The status of a video or music job, its progress and, once it succeeded, the links to its files and what it cost.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model: its price, what it makes and, for an image, video, music or speech model, a JSON Schema of the options a request takes (parameters).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Models you can call right now, with their price. Filter by type (chat, image, video, music, speech, transcription) and by words in the id or name.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Check an image, video, music or text-to-speech request against the model and price it, without making anything or spending. Returns the listed price (cost_usd: it is never billed more) and what is held while it runs (max_cost_usd).

tools.name: start_video
tools.description: Start making a video. Returns a job; call wait_job with its id until it is done. Spends from your balance when the video is made; a failed job costs nothing.

tools.name: wait_job
tools.description: Wait until a video or music job ends, for at most timeout_seconds (50 at most). Returns the job; if done is false, call wait_job again.
